messages:
maria-finance: FYI — AWS Marketplace invoice for Apr (acct x-123) shows $19,200 charged to our reseller account. Expected ~ $17k after partner discount. Anyone seen this?

tom-accounting: Can you paste the invoice id and billing period? I want to pull the settlement report.

maria-finance: Invoice INV-2024-04-3789, period 2024-04-01 to 2024-04-30. Posting date 2024-05-10. Attached snippet below (pdf in finance drive).

maria-finance: ```
SKU                | Usage | Gross $  | Partner discount | Net $
redwood-pro-std   | 1,200h| 21,000   | -4,200           | 16,800
Marketplace fee    |      -|  1,400   |                  | 1,400
Total charged      |       | 22,400   | -4,200           | 18,200
```

jess-ops: Looks like AWS posted gross charges and the partner credit didn't apply on the invoice line — marketplace often shows vendor gross and issues a separate credit settlement. Did you check the AWS settlement report for REF credits? :thinking: 

billing-bot: AWS Marketplace settlement for acct x-123 processed 2024-05-12. Found settlement lines: REF-237 (reseller credit) for -$2,000 issued 2024-05-12, status: PENDING until reconciliation.

rohan-partners: @maria-finance thanks for flagging. Our reseller flow adds a separate credit invoice; accounting sometimes posts the gross invoice and then applies credit. We need to reconcile settlement REF-237 with INV-2024-04-3789. Can you upload the settlement CSV?

maria-finance: Uploaded settlement CSV to /finance/marketplace/aws/INV-2024-04-3789-settlement.csv. The CSV shows REF-237 but no matching credit invoice number.

tom-accounting: I'll open a support case with AWS Marketplace (case #MC-20240514-982). Action items: 1) request official credit invoice number for REF-237, 2) ask why credit not netted on main invoice, 3) request expected payout date.

priya-fp&a: For timing: the variance is $2,200 vs expected ~ $17k. We can book an interim adjustment JE up to $5k to avoid month-end revenue variance, but need final AWS doc to reverse if credit lands. Approving interim JE is okay.

rohan-partners: Good. Tom — if you need partner ops context, I can join the AWS case call. Also check that our reseller discount config on Marketplace listing still points to the correct partner account (we had a recent migration).

tom-accounting: Will do. I'll post updates here after AWS replies. For bookkeeping: proposing JE (debit accounts receivable $2,200 / credit marketplace revenue $2,200) with memo "interim recon for INV-2024-04-3789 pending marketplace credit REF-237". Priya ok with that?

priya-fp&a: Approved. Keep GL tag MARKETPLACE-ADJ and include original invoice + settlement CSV in the JE support docs.

maria-finance: Thanks everyone. Tagging this to the month-end checklist. @rohan-partners please confirm partner-side config by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Case MC-20240514-982 created with AWS Support. Estimated SLA 3-5 business days. Case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/MC-20240514-982

tom-accounting: Noted. If AWS issues the formal credit, we'll reverse the JE in the same period. If no credit, we'll keep adjustment and escalate.

maria-finance: Closing loop for now — will update when AWS responds. Thanks!
